setup: Start Claude Code with the plugin loaded. Each case can also be checked without a model: echo the event JSON into python3 -I hooks/install_guard.py. Do not approve a blocked install.

positive.scenario: Claude is about to install a misspelled package.
positive.expected_result: Denied. The reason names requests as the package it imitates, and the command does not run.

last_run.how: Real hook run directly with the Claude Code event JSON on stdin and live api.osv.dev. No model and no install.
last_run.observed: permissionDecision deny: looks like a typosquat of requests

positive.scenario: Claude is about to install a version reported as malware.

positive.scenario: An exact pinned version has known advisories.
